title: Rippers — Deeper Bonds
description: The campaign's Deeper Bonds system (Aaron Jolliffe playtest) for Project FU: bond tiers (fleeting/solid/eternal), 4-section Bond Clocks on solid bonds, a strength ladder, and invoke = +strength retroactive to the roll just made (via FU's check-push). Extends FU bonds without forking. P1: data model + clocks + tiered caps + invoke wiring.

rippers-deeper-bonds.note: v0.1.1: P1 + sheet tier-CRUD buttons (Solidify cap-checked, Promote Eternal, per-row tier tag + clock, section-level New Fleeting Bond) — UI over existing API, no data-model change, GM-only. Extends FU bonds via flags; clock-strength -> bond.bonus. Invoke piggybacks FU check-push. projectfu pinned 4.16.0/4.16.2. See COVERAGE.md.
